content.text:
You can now print selected prescriptions from both pages. Each print button opens the existing `PrintPrescriptions` page. Prettier, ESLint and `tsc --noEmit` all pass. The one ESLint warning (setState inside an effect) was already in `PrescriptionQueue.tsx`. I haven't tried it in the browser or added a Playwright test.

**New route:** [LocationLayout.tsx](src/pages/Facility/locations/LocationLayout.tsx) now has `/medication_requests/patient/:patientId/prescriptions/:prescriptionIds/print`, which takes comma-separated IDs. I added it here rather than in `ConsultationRoutes` so it follows the existing `/medication_dispense/order/:id/print` route. That way the print page keeps the pharmacy location's sidebar and context, and the buttons can use relative links like the rest of the pharmacy pages.

**Button placement:**
- **[PrescriptionQueue.tsx](src/pages/Facility/services/pharmacy/PrescriptionQueue.tsx):** in the selection bar, between the "Preview selected Rx" link and "Bill selected prescriptions". It's an outline button with a printer icon labelled "Print Selected", so it sits visually between the text link and the main bill action. Like "Bill selected", it's disabled when nothing is selected. The selection bar only appears when the queue is filtered by patient on the Active tab, so that's the only place this button shows up.
- **[PrescriptionsPreviewPage.tsx](src/pages/Facility/services/pharmacy/PrescriptionsPreviewPage.tsx):** on the right of the toolbar, just left of "Start Billing", as an outline button the same size. It prints every prescription on the preview page. It also shows when nothing is active, so completed or cancelled prescriptions can be reprinted. The label switches between "Print Prescription" and "Print Prescriptions" depending on the count.

All the labels use translation keys that already exist (`print_selected`, `print_prescription`, `print_prescriptions`), so `en.json` didn't need changes.

The dispense order page now has a "Print Rx" link next to "Preview Rx". Prettier, ESLint and `tsc` pass. I haven't checked it in the browser.

- **[DispenseOrderView.tsx](src/pages/Facility/services/pharmacy/DispenseOrderView.tsx):** "Print Rx" sits right of "Preview Rx" in the filter row, with the same gray link style and a printer icon. It uses the same prescription IDs as "Preview Rx" and opens the print route I added earlier. It only shows when "Preview Rx" does, so only when the order has prescriptions linked to it.
- **[en.json](public/locale/en.json):** I added `"print_rx": "Print Rx"` so the label matches "Preview Rx".
